A [[skill trainer]] is an [[NPC]] that can teach a [[roleplaying character]] a set of [[skill]]s specific to each trainer. With the exception of [[Halbrik]] in [[pre-Searing]], trainers can also teach characters any non-[[elite skill|elite]] skills from the [[List of core skills|core set]] and from their [[campaign]] that are already [[unlock]]ed on the [[account]]. These unlocked skills are not offered to characters who have taken [[Melandru's Accord]]. Trainers can be easily identified by the "[Skills]" suffix in their name.

== Purchasing a skill ==
Each skill costs a [[skill point]] ({{skill point}}) and an amount of gold that depends on the number of skills already purchased by that character. The first skill costs only {{cost|50}} and progresses up to a maximum of {{cost|1000}} for the twenty-first and all subsequent skills. This cost is halved for characters in [[reforged mode]]. See [[#Skill cost progression|Notes]] for the detailed progression.

== Alternatives to skill trainers ==

=== Cost savings ===
There are three other ways that [[PvE character]]s can acquire skills without spending money at a skill trainer:
* '''[[list of skill quests|Skill quests]]''' are [[Skill rewards|free]]; often, they are also quick and easy. Beware of diminishing returns: some of the later skill quests can be long or tedious.
* '''[[Skill tome]]s''' allow characters to learn unlocked skills and either free (through [[drop]]s) or relatively cheap (via [[trade]]s with other players or through [[zaishen coin]]s).
* '''[[Hero skill trainer]]s''' in [[Nightfall]] and [[Eye of the North]] will teach you skills in exchange for zero gold and one [[hero skill point]]. Up to 73 hero skill points can be acquired for free; purchasing additional points provides no monetary advantage over regular skill trainers.

=== Other alternatives ===
* '''{{skill icon|Signet of Capture}}''' can be used to learn skills earlier than you might from a trainer, but the signets costs the same as any other skill.

== Notes ==
* The first 20 skills purchased by a character will cost a total of {{cost|6450}}. Any skills purchased after the first 20 cost {{cost|1000}} each.
** The price is reduced for characters in {{reforgedmode}}, for a total of {{cost|3175}} for the first 20 skills and {{cost|500}} per skill thereafter.
* Skill trainers don't teach [[elite skills]]. You must capture them from [[boss]]es with {{skill icon|Signet of Capture}} or learn already unlocked ones with [[elite tome]]s.
* Skill trainers don't teach [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only skills]]. Check each skill's article for its specific acquisition method.
